section.title: GitOps
section.hint: Flux and Argo CD are installed from their official manifests through the Kubernetes API.
section.notConnected: Connect to the cluster to see whether Flux and Argo CD are installed.

dialog.title: Install {{tool}}
dialog.flux: Flux is installed as `flux install` does by default: the source, kustomize, helm and notification controllers in flux-system, without image automation.
dialog.argoCd: Argo CD is installed from its standard install.yaml into argocd: cluster-wide, with the web UI, not highly available.

versions.label: Version
versions.error: Could not get the list of releases from GitHub, so only the tested version {{version}} is offered.

preview.verified: matches the checksums file of the release
preview.unverified: the project publishes no checksum for this file
preview.warning: Installing changes the whole cluster: it creates CustomResourceDefinitions, ClusterRoles and ClusterRoleBindings. It needs cluster-admin rights.
preview.noCrdAccess: You may not create CustomResourceDefinitions in this cluster, so the install will probably fail.
preview.noBindingAccess: You may not create ClusterRoleBindings in this cluster, so the install will probably fail.
preview.present: {{tool}} is already installed. Its objects will be updated to this version.
preview.partial: {{tool}} is partly installed (its namespace or some of its CRDs exist). Existing objects will be updated.
preview.overwritten: These cluster-wide objects already exist and will be overwritten:
preview.leftOut: Running in {{namespace}}: {{names}}. This install leaves image automation and the source watcher out, as `flux install` does, and removes their service accounts from the shared role bindings, so they lose their permissions.

progress.waiting: Everything is applied. Waiting for the controllers to be ready (up to 5 minutes)…

result.done: {{tool}} {{version}} is installed and running. Its section is in the sidebar.
result.timedOut: Everything was applied, but not every controller was ready within 5 minutes. What was applied stays in the cluster.
result.stopped: The install was stopped. {{count}} objects were applied; the rest were not sent.
result.failed: The install failed. Nothing after the failed object was sent; what was applied stays in the cluster.

argo.login: Sextant signs in to Argo CD by itself with the argocd-initial-admin-secret. Change the admin password in Argo CD, then delete that secret.

confirmStop.title: Stop the install?
confirmStop.text: The install stops after the object being applied. What was applied stays in the cluster.
